title: Deadlock-prevention analysis with optional GenAI reflection
summary: Third-year database students analyze and compare two deadlock-prevention schemes in a graded assignment question. They may use GenAI for this question, but must disclose the tool and explain in no more than six sentences why it helped more than course materials; non-users explain their choice and learning source.
